text: 近日，蘑菇物联与全球工业自动化巨头三菱电机集团旗下核心上市公司——株式会社RYODEN、菱商电子（上海）有限公司达成战略合作。本次合作将围绕能效领域的物理AI控制展开技术合作与市场拓展。
text_en: Recently, Mushroom IoT has reached a strategic cooperation agreement with RYODEN CO., LTD., a core listed company under the global industrial automation giant Mitsubishi Electric Group, and Matsusho Electronics (Shanghai) Co., Ltd. This cooperation will focus on technical collaboration and market expansion around physical AI control in the energy efficiency field.
